title: Fix plan 18 signoff gaps: ToolEnvSandbox wiring + missing test categories
description:
Follow-up work from plan 18 completion signoff (aiag-r3z.1 — Partial status).

Contractual gap:
- AgentLoopService.CreateSession rejects ToolEnvSandbox and uses noop tools (buildNoopTools).
  Plan §4 specifies constructing ExecutionEnvironment from ToolEnvironmentConfig:
  ToolEnvLocal -> environment.NewLocalEnvironment(rootDir)
  ToolEnvSandbox -> native.NewNativeSandboxEnvironment(sandboxClient, config)
  Fix: implement the ToolEnvSandbox branch in CreateSession, building a real
  NativeSandboxEnvironment and wiring actual tools.

Missing test categories:
- DV1/DV2: Dedicated termmux dual-view independence/failure tests per test harness §11
- GS2: Force-shutdown-after-deadline assertion (GS1/GS3 exist, GS2 missing)
- B5/B6: Benchmark functions matching test harness §14 labels

After fixing, re-verify and upgrade both signoff sections to Complete.

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §4 (CreateSession flow steps 7-8)
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §11, §12, §14

comments.author: Danny Cosson
comments.text: Implemented ToolEnvSandbox runtime tool wiring in AgentLoopService via injectable ToolCatalogFactory; added runtime catalog factory + sandbox RPC client wiring, DV1/DV2 + GS2 tests, B5/B6 benchmarks, and updated both plan-18 completion signoff sections to Complete. Verification: make check PASS, make test PASS.
